changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs v0.2.0 backfill (1/2): copy existing jobs.log text into a staging column before the lib-jobs library changelog drops jobs.log and creates job_logs (see lib-jobs DESIGN.md 8). The library's own changeset creates job_logs and drops jobs.log in one atomic changeset, so the copy has to happen before it runs, not in between.

sql.sql: UPDATE jobs SET log_backfill = log WHERE log IS NOT NULL
